acceptanceCriteria: Regression with a high-degree star compares exact rank maps and convergence with current implementation.
Operation-count or focused benchmark proves degree summation occurs at most once per visited node, including subthreshold hub cases.
Run a representative complete context command with graph on and off before making a latency benefit claim; preserve graph-off packet parity.
body:
Comprehensive expert audit 2026-09-26, PERF-01. Audited source 2961076fc0b78bfab743578f2ef5c17006be058a. Evidence classification: high for redundant algorithmic work; end-to-end impact unmeasured.

With CORVINT_CONTEXT_GRAPH=on, many distinct identifiers connecting a hub source to separate leaf sources produce repeated degree scans while the hub is below its residual threshold. This increases kernel work superlinearly despite staying below the node, arc and 200000-push bounds. Default graph-off behavior is unaffected.

Source: internal/contextindex/ppr.go:209

Owning contract/status: "TCP-V0-031 and TCP-V0-033 (proposed experimental): deterministic forward-push PageRank and explicit graph/push bounds. This is an optimization gap within the stated numeric bounds, not a demonstrated violation of an accepted latency SLO."

Verification: {"actual": "Pinned source 2961076fc0b78bfab743578f2ef5c17006be058a. Scratch Go harness extracted personalizedPageRank and degree verbatim, adding operation counters only, and supplied symmetric unit-weight CSR stars. 1000/2000/4000/8000 leaves caused 3428000/14050000/56820000/225296000 degree-edge visits; 14015/24013/40010/64008 pushes, all converged. Scratch single-run kernel times were 8.42/31.84/126.90/482.06 ms, diagnostic only. Outputs ppr-cost.txt, harness ppr-cost.go. Source identgraph.go allows such stars through distinct eligible names; reference-per-name cap does not bound source degree.", "notRun": "No full context command on synthetic Git star; no source regression suite, cold/warm distribution, CPU profile, before/after patch or speedup measurement."}

Suggested correction: Memoize weighted degree per node for the walk, preserving exact uint64 summation and float conversion. Keep the rank arithmetic/order unchanged. Do not change the snapshot schema merely to cache a derivable value.

Report: .agent-evidence/2026-09-26-comprehensive-audit.md; retained expert and reproduction evidence in .agent-evidence/audit-20260926/. Run focused regressions and owning documentation checks; exhaustive gate only when governing release policy requires it. No implementation, intent acceptance or promotion is claimed.
title: Experimental PageRank repeatedly scans hub adjacency to recompute an unchanged degree
